ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Ah, hola de nuevo{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
¿Tú qué crees, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
¿Va a parar de llover pronto?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Encore bonjour{{TAG:0007:0007:}}.
Ah, cette pluie ! Penses-tu qu'elle
s'arrêtera bientôt, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0007:0006:}}Ariciao{{TAG:0007:0007:}}!
Pensi che smetterà di piovere
presto, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}An umbrella, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}
I can't imagine WHY you'd use one
on a lovely day like today.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Now, on a hot, summery day?
THAT I could understand,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Oh! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿Un paraguas, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}
¿Cómo puedes llevar paraguas
en un día tan espléndido?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si brillara un sol abrasador
lo entendería, pero hoy no,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Quoi ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Un parapluie, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}
Mais pour quoi faire ? Pour une fois
qu'il fait un temps superbe !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Une ombrelle par un jour d'été
ensoleillé je comprendrais, mais là...
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}In giro con l'ombrello,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} E perché mai, in una
giornata bella come questa?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Capisco in un giorno afoso col sole
battente, ma per pararsi dalla
pioggia proprio no, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wieso hast du denn
einen Schirm?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Und das an einem
so wunderschönen Tag!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}An einem heißen, sonnigen Tag kann
ich das ja noch verstehen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}aber
so... {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Aaa! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Şemsiye mi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Böyle güzel
bir günde onu NEDEN kullanasın, hiç
anlayamıyorum. {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ama sıcak bir yaz gününde
güneşten korunmak için? İŞTE onu
anlarım, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Hey! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}No umbrella in all this rain?!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Sorry. You just surprised me,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I usually see everyone trying to
stay dry. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}But I'm with you.
Let's soak it up, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}¡Oye! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡¿No llevas paraguas?!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}No, es que me has sorprendido,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A casi nadie le apetece empaparse.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Pero estoy contigo! ¡A mojarse,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Hello ! {{TAG:0003:0011:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tiens, tu n'as pas de
parapluie ?!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Là on peut dire que tu
me surprends, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En général les gens ne veulent pas
se mouiller. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Mais toi tu aimes l'eau
on dirait, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Ma come... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}In giro senza ombrello?!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Uau, mi sorprendi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Vedo che tutti fanno il possibile per
non bagnarsi. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Beh, io sono con te!
Inzuppiamoci, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Huch?! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du hast gar keinen
Regenschirm?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Entschuldige, ich
bin nur überrascht, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sonst wollen alle immer trocken
bleiben. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Haha! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wir zwei genießen
die Wasserflut, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Hey! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Bu yağmurda şemsiyesiz misin?!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Pardon. Beni şaşırttın, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Herkes kuru kalmaya çalışır sanırdım.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ama ben senden yanayım. Hadi iyice
ıslanalım, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Y si llueve tanto porque hay
alguien llorando ahí arriba?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Si es así...
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}}¡Eh! ¡El de ahí arriba! ¡Deja ya
de lloriquear!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Que nos vamos a
ahogar aquí abajo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}On dit que quand il pleut, c'est que
le ciel est triste et qu'il pleure.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Tu y crois, toi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
{{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Hé, toi là-haut !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Arrête-donc un peu
de pleurnicher, je suis déjà toute
trempée !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Non pensi anche tu che le gocce
di pioggia siano lacrime che cadono
da un cielo che piange?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Come no?!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Oh, forse leggo troppi romanzi rosa.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Meglio che vada ad asciugarmi,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Acaba gökyüzü ağladığı için mi yağmur
durmuyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Öyleyse... {{TAG:0007:000A:}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Kes şu hüngürdemeyi
yukarıda!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} İliklerime
kadar ıslandım, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Soy muy refinada y me gusta
mantener las formas, pero
el barro es superior a mí...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Me encantaría revolcarme! {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si no
fuera porque dejaría el suelo
de casa perdido, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Toute cette pluie... et toute cette
boue...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Même je suis quelqu'un de
très propre, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}j'avoue que...
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}J'ai une folle envie de patauger
dedans !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Mais, ça ruinerait tous mes
vêtements, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}E così pensavi che fossi inorridita
dal fango, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}È vero, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}amo la pulizia,
ma se vedo una pozzanghera.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}... devo subito saltarci dentro!
Beh, a meno che non abbia appena
passato lo straccio, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bunca çamurun yanına bile yaklaşmak
istemem sanırdın, değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Biraz
titizim, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}biliyorum. Ama vallahi içinde
yuvarlanabilirdim. {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}Tabii,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}sonra tertemiz
evime çamur taşımayacak
olsam, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}You know, I'd like rain a LOT
more if it wasn't so wet,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿Sabes? La lluvia me gustaría
más si no mojara, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Tu sais, la pluie, ça mouille. Et c'est
bien là qu'est le problème,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Sai, la pioggia non mi seccherebbe
così tanto se non fosse così...
umida, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Also, ich fände Regen wesentlich
erträglicher, wenn er nicht so
nass wäre, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Biliyor musun, yağmur bu kadar ISLAK
olmasa onu ÇOK daha fazla
severdim, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Cada gota que cae es como la
nota de una hermosa melodía!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Es que tú no la oyes, flor?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Écoute... {{TAG:0007:0001:}}La pluie est une mélodie,
et chacune des gouttes qui la
composent en est une note.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Comment ? Tu n'aimes pas ce genre
de musique ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bah, les gouttes et les
couleurs, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Her yağmur damlası güzel bir senfonideki
nota gibi! {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ne?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Böyle hisseden
yalnızca BEN miyim?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm getting so soaked out here,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Oh, what I wouldn't
GIVE to be a frog sometimes.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Estoy empapada hasta los huesos,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Lo que daría por
ser una rana...
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Pff ! Je suis trempée jusqu'aux os,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Dans ces moments-là
j'aimerais être une grenouille.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sono fradicia, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Almeno le lumache che mi infestano
il giardino sembrano contente.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Burada sırılsıklam oluyorum, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bazen kurbağa olmayı ne ÇOK isterdim.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}De la pluie,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} des flaques, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}de la boue
partout... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}La ville toute entière s'est
changée en étang, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

{{TAG:0003:000A:}}D'accord,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} un peu de pluie ça fait du
bien{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Mais là, il pleut sans arrêt !
Vivement demain, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Etwas Regen ist ja nett! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Aber wieso
denn gleich so viel? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Hoffentlich wird
es morgen besser, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Oh, it's SO lovely. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}My skin is just
getting slimier and slimier in
all this rain, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}¡Es fantástico! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Mira mi piel!
¡Está brillante y resbaladiza con
tanta lluvia, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
¡Esto no se consigue ni en los
mejores salones de belleza!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Oh, magnifique ! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ma peau devient de
plus en plus visqueuse grâce à la
pluie. Touche-moi ça, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Aaa, ne KADAR hoş. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Bu yağmurda tenim
gittikçe daha kaygan, daha sümüksü
oluyor, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
